name: comp-334
title: Accordion With Chevron
blurb: Accordion with chevron icon showing/hiding per item.
description: Origin UI accordion variant using Radix UI primitives. Chevron icon rotates 180° on expand, styled with hover effects.
use_when: FAQ pages with visual expand/collapse indicators and hover feedback.
avoid_when: When chevron rotation feels excessive — some users find it distracting.
a11y: Chevron is aria-hidden (purely decorative). Button has aria-expanded.
